exposure: pinned baseline documentation, source, public tests
rule: Rank by primary-subject selection_feature_ids intersecting target_features, then common_features, then fixed corpus path and byte start. Source chapter tags identify their subject; researcher reconstructions explicitly distinguish primary subject from shared capabilities.
